fills.researcher_notes: One question per company, answered once for the whole Makat–North Caucasus system (P1476 trunk + P3999 loop) and applied to both rows, per the brief's instruction — stated explicitly here and on P3999. Operator on the sheet is on the operators_owners tab and was blank; the brief asks specifically for the KAZAKH-section operator, not a system-wide blend (Gazprom Transgaz Makhachkala operates the Russian side per gem.wiki, not cited). Kazakh section = АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия» (Intergas Central Asia JSC), via its Atyrau branch (УМГ «Атырау»). Sources, three independent origins: (1) Intergas's own corporate 'General information' page states the branch-to-pipeline assignment directly — 'УМГ «Атырау»: МГ «Макат-Северный Кавказ», Лупинг «Макат-Северный Кавказ», МГ «Средняя Азия - Центр» с лупингами' — i.e. UMG Atyrau operates both the trunk and its loop. (2) inform.kz (2023-05-30, an independent Kazakh news wire, not QazaqGaz/Intergas-published), reporting the loop's launch: 'АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия» осуществило строительство Лупинга МГ «Макат-Северный Кавказ»' (Intergas Central Asia built the loop), commissioned 2023-05-30 at 13.147 bcm/y design capacity, QazaqGaz + the Atyrau akimat launching it. (3) QazaqGaz's KASE-filed Integrated Annual Report 2023 (kztgp_2023_rus.pdf) lists both 'МГ «Макат – Северный Кавказ»' and 'МГ «Лупинг Макат – Северный Кавказ»' under the heading 'АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия» осуществляет эксплуатацию следующих магистральных газопроводов' (p.21–22 of the PDF; url_verifier's substring check false-negatives on this large PDF — confirmed locally with `pdftotext -layout`, a documented case per the protocol). This also happens to be the same document the country note calls the 'QazaqGaz Integrated Annual Report' 2024 vintage lists lines by name only — this is the 2023 vintage, same shape. Did not propose an Owner or Parent fill for this row — see validity[].

P1476's route is the original 1988 trunk (944 km, built over decades, plausibly using more than one pipe diameter); P3999 is the single-diameter 2023 loop. No independent source found that assigns 1020 mm to P1476 itself, so the sheet's existing 1200/1400/1420 split is correct as-is.
